description: Organizes content into sections that readers can expand and collapse.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
<tp-accordion open-indexes="1">
    <dl>
      <dt>What is HTML?</dt><dd>The language used to structure web pages.</dd>
      <dt>What is CSS?</dt><dd>The language used to style web pages.</dd>
      <dt>What is Javascript?</dt><dd>The language used to define the behaviour of web pages.</dd>
    </dl>
    </tp-accordion>

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Allows several sections to remain open simultaneously.

attributes.name: open-indexes
attributes.description: Space-separated, zero-based indexes of the open sections.

methods.name: close(index: number): void
methods.description: Closes the section at the zero-based index without changing other sections.

methods.name: open(index: number): void
methods.description: Opens the section at the zero-based index; in single mode, closes the previously open section.

methods.name: toggle(index: number): void
methods.description: Toggles the section at the zero-based index, respecting the single/multiple opening mode.

cssproperties.name: --tp-accordion-content-gap
cssproperties.description: Gap between an accordion heading and its content.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-accordion>` element organizes content into sections that readers can expand and collapse.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Section heading | Click to expand or collapse its content. Opening a section may close the previous section. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Focus a section heading. |
| <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd> | Moves focus to the next header. |
| <kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> | Moves focus to the previous header. |
| <kbd>Home</kbd> | Moves focus to the first header. |
| <kbd>End</kbd> | Moves focus to the last header. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Expands or collapses the focused section. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
